name: Hive (Dart)
tagline: Lightweight pure-Dart key-value store for Flutter; development continues in the Hive CE fork.
description: Hive is a key-value database written in pure Dart, popular in Flutter apps because it needs no native code, works on mobile, desktop and web, and is very fast for small reads and writes. Data lives in boxes (one file each), optionally AES-256 encrypted, and typed objects are stored via generated TypeAdapters. It works well for settings, caches and modest local state, but it has no query language or indexes beyond keys. The original package has not been released since 2.2.3 in June 2022, and the community-maintained Hive CE (hive_ce) is where fixes and new Dart support now land.
statusNote: Original hive package unreleased since 2.2.3 (June 2022); active development moved to the community fork Hive CE (hive_ce).
developer: Simon Choi and the Hive community

scale.notes: Boxes are loaded into memory by default; lazy boxes help with larger data.

strengths: Pure Dart with no native dependencies, so it runs on Flutter web too
Very fast key reads and writes for small objects
Simple box-based API with optional AES-256 encryption
weaknesses: Original package is unmaintained; you need to switch to Hive CE for fixes
No queries or secondary indexes, only key access and full scans
Not built for large datasets or relational data
useCases: Small typed object stores in Flutter apps
